snippet.description:
Christa Pike was going to be the first woman executed in Tennessee. But she survived two doses of the lethal injection. Vox’s Miles Bryan talked to journalist and author Pamela Colloff about what this case opens up about the wider issues  with the death penalty. 

Listen to the full episode of The Gray Area wherever you get your podcasts.
